verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk data export or account takeout feature in open formats. The REST API returning JSON is a developer building block someone could use to construct an export. Third-party extractors such as Fivetran and Airbyte are external tools, not Asana's own capability, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON or form-encoded requests, returns JSON
